review:
Aloha King Elvis is the sequel to Elvis Frog in Vegas, taking the frog to Hawaii. It's a 5x3, 25-line slot with free spins, a Coin Respin feature and jackpots.

Six or more coins trigger a coin-only bonus with three respins; each new coin resets the count and all coins stay until the end. Filling one, two or three horizontal lines with coins wins the Mini (20x), Major (100x) or Mega (1,000x) jackpot, and a random Collect symbol can gather the value of every coin on screen. Three scatters on reels 1, 3 and 5 trigger free spins. Chance x2.5 and a bonus buy are available where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-high volatility with a 2,000x maximum. The RTP is 94.98%.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
